pairs.target: dìèrtiān xiàwǔ , sè lā méiyǒu chuān nàshuāng yìng dǐ xié .
pairs.english: The next afternoon, Sela did not wear her hard-soled shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天下午，瑟拉没有穿那双硬底鞋。

pairs.target: yìng dǐ xié kànzhe qízhěng , zǒu jiǔ liǎo què dǐng xīgài .
pairs.english: The hard-soled shoes looked neat, but strained her knees on a long walk.
pairs.hanzi: 硬底鞋看着齐整，走久了却顶膝盖。

pairs.target: tā huànshàng bǔguò liǎngcì de ruǎnxié , gēn tǎ wéi yán huǎnpō rào dào huòzhàn hòumiàn .
pairs.english: She changed into soft shoes that had been mended twice and went with Tavi along the gentle slope around to the back of the freight station.
pairs.hanzi: 她换上补过两次的软鞋，跟塔维沿缓坡绕到货站后面。

pairs.target: tā fàngmàn jiǎobù , shǒu shēnguòqù yícì , bèi tā yòng bùdài qīngqīng dǎngkāi .
pairs.english: He slowed his steps and once reached out a hand; she gently pushed it aside with her cloth bag.
pairs.hanzi: 他放慢脚步，手伸过去一次，被她用布袋轻轻挡开。

pairs.target: " hái méi dào yào nǐ tuō zhe zǒu de shíhòu . "
pairs.english: “I'm not yet at the stage where you need to drag me along.”
pairs.hanzi: “还没到要你拖着走的时候。”

pairs.target: ménqián de chángdèng shì kōng de .
pairs.english: The bench outside the door was empty.
pairs.hanzi: 门前的长凳是空的。

pairs.target: sè lā zuòxià xiēqì , tǎ wéi tì tā nǐng kāishuǐhú .
pairs.english: Sela sat to catch her breath, and Tavi unscrewed the water flask for her.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉坐下歇气，塔维替她拧开水壶。

pairs.target: zuótiān huà dìzhǐ shí , tā zhī xiǎngzhe xìn zěnme sòng huíjiā ;
pairs.english: When he drew the address yesterday, he had only thought about how letters would get home;
pairs.hanzi: 昨天画地址时，他只想着信怎么送回家；

pairs.target: jīntiān péi tā zǒu zhè duàn lù , cái zhīdào zhǐ shàng nà jǐbǐ shěngdiào le duōshǎo táijiē .
pairs.english: walking this stretch with her today, he realized how many steps those few strokes on paper had left out.
pairs.hanzi: 今天陪她走这段路，才知道纸上那几笔省掉了多少台阶。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài mén lǐ děng tāmen , shǒuzhōng duō le liǎngzhāng báozhǐ .
pairs.english: Nerai waited for them inside the door, with two extra sheets of thin paper in her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在门里等他们，手中多了两张薄纸。

pairs.target: " huò dài de shì yǒu huíxìn . " tā xiān bǎ zhǐ gěi tǎ wéi kàn ,
pairs.english: “There's a reply about the freight sacks.” First she showed Tavi the papers.
pairs.hanzi: “货袋的事有回信。”她先把纸给塔维看，

pairs.target: " zhuǎnyùn shí dài dǐ pò le , sāndài bìng chéng liǎngdài .
pairs.english: “A sack split at the bottom during transfer, and three sacks were combined into two.
pairs.hanzi: “转运时袋底破了，三袋并成两袋。

pairs.target: yùndān jì le huàn dài , yuánlái de pǐnlèi dān què zhàochāo ,
pairs.english: The waybill recorded the repacking, but they copied the original classification sheet unchanged,
pairs.hanzi: 运单记了换袋，原来的品类单却照抄，

pairs.target: méi bǎ hùnjìnlái de fèijiàn bǔ shàng . "
pairs.english: without adding the scrap parts that had been mixed in.”
pairs.hanzi: 没把混进来的废件补上。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū ā duó shōutiáo shàng de hàomǎ , xiàmiàn yǒu liǎnggè bú rènshi de qiānmíng .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the number from Ado's receipt, with two unfamiliar signatures below.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出阿铎收条上的号码，下面有两个不认识的签名。

pairs.target: " nà yìméi qián ne ? "
pairs.english: “What about that one coin?”
pairs.hanzi: “那一枚钱呢？”

pairs.target: " hái bùnéng dìng . xiànzài néng gǎi de shì shōu liào jìlù .
pairs.english: “We can't settle that yet. What can be corrected now is the receiving record.
pairs.hanzi: “还不能定。现在能改的是收料记录。

pairs.target: kòudiào de jiūjìng yǒu duōshǎo shì yóuní , duōshǎo shì àn cuò pǐnlèi suàn de , dé chóngxīn hé .
pairs.english: Exactly how much was deducted for oily sludge and how much came from using the wrong classification must be checked again.
pairs.hanzi: 扣掉的究竟有多少是油泥，多少是按错品类算的，得重新核。

pairs.target: ā duó dé dài zìjǐ de shōutiáo qù . "
pairs.english: Ado needs to take his own receipt.”
pairs.hanzi: 阿铎得带自己的收条去。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ qízhōng yìzhāng jiāogěi tā , shì zhǔnxǔ cházhàng de huí tiáo .
pairs.english: She handed him one of the sheets, a reply slip authorizing an account review.
pairs.hanzi: 她把其中一张交给他，是准许查账的回条。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhé hǎo fàngjìn wài dài , miǎnde tóng shēnqǐng hùn zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi folded it into an outer pocket so it would not get mixed up with the application.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维折好放进外袋，免得同申请混在一起。

pairs.target: yǒurén kěn rèn jìlù cuò le , tā hěn gāoxìng ;
pairs.english: He was glad someone was willing to acknowledge the records were wrong;
pairs.hanzi: 有人肯认记录错了，他很高兴；

pairs.target: qián hái méiyǒu huídào ā duó shǒulǐ , tā yě jì zhe .
pairs.english: he also kept in mind that the money was not back in Ado's hands yet.
pairs.hanzi: 钱还没有回到阿铎手里，他也记着。

pairs.target: wūnèi yǒurén jiào tā de míngzì .
pairs.english: Someone inside called his name.
pairs.hanzi: 屋内有人叫他的名字。

pairs.target: shěnlǐ de zhuōzi bìng bù gāo , zhǐshì kuān .
pairs.english: The hearing table was not particularly tall, just wide.
pairs.hanzi: 审理的桌子并不高，只是宽。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi , sè lā hé nài lěi zuòzài yìbiān ,
pairs.english: Tavi, Sela and Nerai sat on one side,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维、瑟拉和奈蕾坐在一边，

pairs.target: duìmiàn zuò zhe yíwèi huīfā nǚrén hé yígè xiùkǒu móliàng de nánrén .
pairs.english: opposite a gray-haired woman and a man whose cuffs were worn shiny.
pairs.hanzi: 对面坐着一位灰发女人和一个袖口磨亮的男人。

pairs.target: nǚrén miànqián shì kǎohé jìlù , nánrén miànqián tānzhe jǐběn zhàng .
pairs.english: The assessment records lay before the woman; several account books were spread before the man.
pairs.hanzi: 女人面前是考核记录，男人面前摊着几本账。

pairs.target: zuótiān shōujiàn de rén gěi shuāngfāng dǎo le shuǐ , biàn tuì dào ménbiān zhěnglǐ xià yífèn shēnqǐng .
pairs.english: Yesterday's receiving clerk poured water for both sides, then withdrew to the door to organize the next application.
pairs.hanzi: 昨天收件的人给双方倒了水，便退到门边整理下一份申请。

pairs.target: huīfā nǚrén xiān wèn sè lā yǎng le tā duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: The gray-haired woman first asked Sela how long she had raised him.
pairs.hanzi: 灰发女人先问瑟拉养了他多久。

pairs.target: sè lā shuō le zìjǐ jìde de nián yuè , yòu shuō nàshí tā hái dé bào zhe zǒu .
pairs.english: Sela gave the year and month as she remembered them, adding that he still had to be carried then.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉说了自己记得的年月，又说那时他还得抱着走。

pairs.target: wèn dào chūshēngdì , tā yáotóu , méiyǒu qù kàn nài lěi .
pairs.english: Asked about his birthplace, she shook her head without looking to Nerai.
pairs.hanzi: 问到出生地，她摇头，没有去看奈蕾。

pairs.target: " zhège wǒ shuōbùchūlái . "
pairs.english: “That I can't tell you.”
pairs.hanzi: “这个我说不出来。”

pairs.target: nǚrén zài kōnglán páng xiě le jǐzì , jiāng zhǐ zhuǎnxiàng jìzhàng de nánrén .
pairs.english: The woman wrote a few characters beside the blank entry and turned the paper toward the man keeping accounts.
pairs.hanzi: 女人在空栏旁写了几字，将纸转向记账的男人。

pairs.target: " jūzhù hé fǔyǎng yǒurén zuòzhèng .
pairs.english: “We have a witness to his residence and upbringing.
pairs.hanzi: “居住和抚养有人作证。

pairs.target: àn dānbǎo tiáomù lì línshí xuéjí , yuánjí dài hé . "
pairs.english: Establish provisional student registration under the sponsorship provision, with place of origin awaiting verification.”
pairs.hanzi: 按担保条目立临时学籍，原籍待核。”

pairs.target: nánrén fān dào hòu yè , zhǐzhe nài lěi de qiānmíng .
pairs.english: The man turned to a later page and pointed to Nerai's signature.
pairs.hanzi: 男人翻到后页，指着奈蕾的签名。

pairs.target: " měijì yào xù rèn . rén bú zài chénglǐ , yě dé yǒurén néng zhǎodào nǐ . "
pairs.english: “You must renew the attestation each season. Even when you're outside the city, someone must be able to reach you.”
pairs.hanzi: “每季要续认。人不在城里，也得有人能找到你。”

pairs.target: " wǒ liúxué gōng de shōuxìn chù hé xíngchéng . biàndòng jiù bào . " nài lěi shuō .
pairs.english: “I'll leave the academy's mailing address and my itinerary. I'll report any changes,” Nerai said.
pairs.hanzi: “我留学宫的收信处和行程。变动就报。”奈蕾说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuányǐwéi dānbǎo jiùshì xiě yígè míngzì .
pairs.english: Tavi had thought sponsorship simply meant writing a name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原以为担保就是写一个名字。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé píngcháng , tā què kànjiàn nánrén jiāng tā de huídá lìngjì zài yìháng shàng .
pairs.english: She spoke casually, but he saw the man record her answer on a separate line.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得平常，他却看见男人将她的回答另记在一行上。

pairs.target: jiēzhe , huīfā nǚrén ná qǐ lǔ cén de kǎohé zhǐ .
pairs.english: Next the gray-haired woman picked up Rutzen's assessment sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 接着，灰发女人拿起鲁岑的考核纸。

pairs.target: " dìyīcì , qiāo le tíngzhǐ , nǐ méi tíng . "
pairs.english: “The first time, the stop signal was tapped, and you didn't stop.”
pairs.hanzi: “第一次，敲了停止，你没停。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de jiǎo wǎng dèngzǐ dǐxià shōu le shōu .
pairs.english: Tavi drew his feet a little farther under the bench.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的脚往凳子底下收了收。

pairs.target: " tīngjiàn le . wǒ xiǎng zài duō zuò yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: “I heard it. I wanted to do a little more.”
pairs.hanzi: “听见了。我想再多做一点。”

pairs.target: " hòulái ne ? "
pairs.english: “And afterward?”
pairs.hanzi: “后来呢？”

pairs.target: tā bǎ sāncì fùshì de cìxù shuōwán .
pairs.english: He recounted the sequence of the three repeat trials.
pairs.hanzi: 他把三次复试的次序说完。

pairs.target: shuō dào dìèrcì méiyǒu dòngjìng , nǚrén wèn , tā zěnme zhīdào nàcì búsuàn shībài .
pairs.english: When he said nothing had moved on the second attempt, the woman asked how he knew that did not count as a failure.
pairs.hanzi: 说到第二次没有动静，女人问，他怎么知道那次不算失败。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng le xiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi thought for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想了想。

pairs.target: " yào kàn shì shénme . ruò shì néng bunéng jiè dào , nàcì méi jiè dào .
pairs.english: “It depends what you're testing. If it was whether I could borrow anything, that time I didn't.
pairs.hanzi: “要看试什么。若试能不能借到，那次没借到。

pairs.target: ruò shì tīngjiàn jiù fàng , wǒ fàng le . "
pairs.english: If it was whether I'd let go when I heard it, I did let go.”
pairs.hanzi: 若试听见就放，我放了。”

pairs.target: nǚrén dītóu kàn le yíbiàn jìlù , jiào tā zhǐrèn zhǐ shàng de diǎn hé duǎnxiàn .
pairs.english: The woman looked down through the records once and asked him to identify the dots and short lines on the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 女人低头看了一遍记录，叫他指认纸上的点和短线。

pairs.target: tā shēnshǒu shí méiyǒu má , shǒuzhǐ yě méiyǒu bèi shuí ànzhù ,
pairs.english: His hand was not numb as he reached out, and nobody was holding his fingers down,
pairs.hanzi: 他伸手时没有麻，手指也没有被谁按住，

pairs.target: què bǐ zài lǔ cén zhuōqián gèng pà zhǐcuò .
pairs.english: yet he was more afraid of pointing wrongly than he had been at Rutzen's table.
pairs.hanzi: 却比在鲁岑桌前更怕指错。

pairs.target: dìyīchù tā shuō dé tài kuài , zìjǐ tíngxià , chóngxīn shuō .
pairs.english: At the first mark he spoke too quickly, stopped himself, and started again.
pairs.hanzi: 第一处他说得太快，自己停下，重新说。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jiào tā dāngchǎng zài zuò yícì .
pairs.english: She did not ask him to perform another trial on the spot.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有叫他当场再做一次。

pairs.target: " zhèlǐ méi bèi héshì de yàngpǐn . rùxué yǐhòu háiyào cè .
pairs.english: “We don't have suitable samples prepared here. You'll be tested again after enrollment.
pairs.hanzi: “这里没备合适的样品。入学以后还要测。

pairs.target: zhè liǎngzhāng tuījiàn zhī shuōmíng nǐ néng kāishǐ xué , bù shuōmíng nǐ yǐjīng huì . "
pairs.english: These two recommendations only show that you can begin learning, not that you already know how.”
pairs.hanzi: 这两张推荐只说明你能开始学，不说明你已经会。”

pairs.target: nánrén jiāng yìzhāng yìn hǎo de biǎo tuīguòlái .
pairs.english: The man pushed a printed form toward them.
pairs.hanzi: 男人将一张印好的表推过来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu xiān jiē , tā cóng dài lǐ chōuchū bó yà xiě de wèntí , pù zài zhuō yán .
pairs.english: Tavi did not take it immediately; he drew Boya's written questions from his bag and spread them along the table's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有先接，他从袋里抽出博娅写的问题，铺在桌沿。

pairs.target: " wǒmen shǎo le zhè zhāng . "
pairs.english: “We were missing this sheet.”
pairs.hanzi: “我们少了这张。”

pairs.target: nánrén kàn le yìyǎn , qǐshēn cóng guìzi lǐ qǔchū liǎngfèn fùbiǎo .
pairs.english: The man glanced at it, stood, and took two copies of the attached schedule from a cabinet.
pairs.hanzi: 男人看了一眼，起身从柜子里取出两份附表。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yífèn jiá zài yuánjiàn hòu , lìng yífèn gěi sè lā .
pairs.english: He clipped one behind the original and gave the other to Sela.
pairs.hanzi: 他把一份夹在原件后，另一份给瑟拉。

pairs.target: " yīngdāng suí tiáokuǎn fā . lòu le . "
pairs.english: “It should have gone out with the terms. It was missed.”
pairs.hanzi: “应当随条款发。漏了。”

pairs.target: sè lā bǎ fùbiǎo fānguòlái , kàn bèimiàn yǒuméiyǒu zì .
pairs.english: Sela turned the schedule over to see whether there was any writing on the back.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉把附表翻过来，看背面有没有字。

pairs.target: " qǐng cóngtóu niàn . wǒmen hái dé dàihuíqù , qǐng rén zài niàn yíbiàn . "
pairs.english: “Please read it from the beginning. We need to take it home and have someone read it again too.”
pairs.hanzi: “请从头念。我们还得带回去，请人再念一遍。”

pairs.target: nánrén diǎntóu , yòng bǐjiān yánzhe gèháng wǎng xiàyí .
pairs.english: The man nodded, moving his pen tip down along the rows.
pairs.hanzi: 男人点头，用笔尖沿着各行往下移。

pairs.target: shìdú liùzhōu , wèi tōngguò , huò zài shìdú jiéshù qián juédìng bùliú , dōu bù zhuī xuéfèi shísù ;
pairs.english: The trial lasted six weeks. If he did not pass, or decided before its end not to stay, neither tuition nor food and lodging would be reclaimed;
pairs.hanzi: 试读六周，未通过，或在试读结束前决定不留，都不追学费食宿；

pairs.target: jièyòng de qìjù yào jiāohuí , sǔnhuài de lìng àn yuányīn chǔlǐ .
pairs.english: borrowed equipment must be returned, and any damage would be handled separately according to its cause.
pairs.hanzi: 借用的器具要交回，损坏的另按原因处理。

pairs.target: shìdú qījiān méiyǒu gōngqián .
pairs.english: There were no wages during the trial.
pairs.hanzi: 试读期间没有工钱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn " méiyǒu gōngqián ", kàn le sè lā yìyǎn .
pairs.english: When Tavi heard “no wages,” he glanced at Sela.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见“没有工钱”，看了瑟拉一眼。

pairs.target: tā méi duǒ tā de mùguāng , yě méi tì tā jiē huà .
pairs.english: She neither avoided his gaze nor answered for him.
pairs.hanzi: 她没躲他的目光，也没替他接话。

pairs.target: " liùzhōu yǐhòu ne ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “What about after six weeks?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “六周以后呢？”他问。

pairs.target: zhèngshì shòuzhù hòu zìxíng tuìxué , xuéfèi réng bù zhuī ,
pairs.english: If he voluntarily withdrew after receiving full funding, tuition would still not be reclaimed,
pairs.hanzi: 正式受助后自行退学，学费仍不追，

pairs.target: yǐ lǐng de shísù zīzhù yào àn yuè hésuàn , zuì duō zhuī yì xuéqī ;
pairs.english: but food and lodging support already received would be calculated by month, with at most one term reclaimed;
pairs.hanzi: 已领的食宿资助要按月核算，最多追一学期；

pairs.target: yīn bìng shāng huò jiāzhōng biàngù tuìchū , kě lìngxíng shēnqǐng jiǎnmiǎn , bùnéng xiān suànzuò yídìng zhǔn .
pairs.english: Anyone leaving because of illness, injury or a family crisis could apply separately for a reduction or waiver, but approval could not be assumed in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 因病伤或家中变故退出，可另行申请减免，不能先算作一定准。

pairs.target: sè lā qǐng tā zài fùbiǎo shàng zhǐchū " zuì duō " nà yìháng ,
pairs.english: Sela asked him to point to the row saying “at most” on the schedule,
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉请他在附表上指出“最多”那一行，

pairs.target: zhǐjiǎ yánzhe zhǐbiān yāchū yídào xiǎo hén .
pairs.english: her fingernail pressing a small mark along the paper's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 指甲沿着纸边压出一道小痕。

pairs.target: bìyè hòu de sānnián zé yào qù chūzīfāng ānpái de gǎngwèi , lìng lǐng gōngqián .
pairs.english: For the three years after graduation he would have to take posts assigned by the funding body, with separate wages.
pairs.hanzi: 毕业后的三年则要去出资方安排的岗位，另领工钱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn néng bunéng liú tóng jiē chéng , nánrén shuō bùnéng bǎozhèng ;
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether he could stay in Copperstep; the man said that could not be guaranteed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问能不能留铜阶城，男人说不能保证；

pairs.target: wèn jīntiān shìfǒu jiùyào qiānxià sānnián , huídá shì xiānqiān shìdú , zhèngshì shòuzhù qián háiyào zài qiān yícì .
pairs.english: Asked whether he must commit to three years today, he answered that only the trial agreement came first; another signature was required before full funding.
pairs.hanzi: 问今天是否就要签下三年，回答是先签试读，正式受助前还要再签一次。

pairs.target: " kě bié dàoshíhòu cái shuō bù zhīdào . " nánrén shuō .
pairs.english: “Just don't say later that you didn't know,” the man said.
pairs.hanzi: “可别到时候才说不知道。”男人说。

pairs.target: huīfā nǚrén jiāng nà yè zhǐ lāhuílái yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The gray-haired woman pulled the page back a little.
pairs.hanzi: 灰发女人将那页纸拉回来一点。

pairs.target: " yě bié xiànzài cuī tā zhuāngzuò dōu dǒng . jīntiān dàizǒu kàn . "
pairs.english: “And don't rush him into pretending he understands everything now. Take it away and read it today.”
pairs.hanzi: “也别现在催他装作都懂。今天带走看。”

pairs.target: chuāngwài xiǎng le yìshēng duǎndí , xiàng shuí bǎ qì chuī chà le .
pairs.english: A short whistle sounded outside the window, as though someone had blown their breath the wrong way.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外响了一声短笛，像谁把气吹岔了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huítóu , jiàn yuànlǐ yígè niánqīngrén zhèng dūn zhe chāi yìzhī tóng ké ,
pairs.english: Tavi turned and saw a young person squatting in the courtyard, taking apart a copper casing,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回头，见院里一个年轻人正蹲着拆一只铜壳，

pairs.target: pángbiān de rén niē zhe xìguǎn xiào .
pairs.english: while someone beside them held a thin tube and laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边的人捏着细管笑。

pairs.target: nà tóng ké zhī bǐ shuǐhú dà xiē , kāikǒu què yǒu liǎngcéng chǐlún .
pairs.english: The copper casing was only a little larger than a water flask, but two tiers of gears showed in its opening.
pairs.hanzi: 那铜壳只比水壶大些，开口却有两层齿轮。

pairs.target: " xuégōng de ? " tā rěnbúzhù wèn .
pairs.english: “From the academy?” he could not help asking.
pairs.hanzi: “学宫的？”他忍不住问。

pairs.target: " èrniánshēng , gěi yìzhàn shì bàoshíqì . " nǚrén shuō ,
pairs.english: “Second-year students, testing a time signal for the relay station,” the woman said.
pairs.hanzi: “二年生，给驿站试报时器。”女人说，

pairs.target: " zuótiān yě méizhǔn diǎn . dàihuìer nǐmen cóng yòubiān zǒu , bié cǎi nàgēn guǎn . "
pairs.english: “It wasn't on time yesterday either. Go round the right when you leave, and don't step on that tube.”
pairs.hanzi: “昨天也没准点。待会儿你们从右边走，别踩那根管。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yòu kàn le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi looked again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维又看了一眼。

pairs.target: dūn zhe de rén bǎ língjiàn pái zài xī qián , mō le bàntiān , hūrán táitóu xiàng tóngbàn yào yíkuài bù .
pairs.english: The person squatting arranged parts in front of their knees, felt around for a while, then suddenly looked up and asked their companion for a cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 蹲着的人把零件排在膝前，摸了半天，忽然抬头向同伴要一块布。

pairs.target: nà dòngzuò tā shúxī , tóng ké lǐmiàn de dōngxī què yíyàng yě bú rènshi .
pairs.english: He knew that movement, but recognized nothing inside the copper casing.
pairs.hanzi: 那动作他熟悉，铜壳里面的东西却一样也不认识。

pairs.target: nǚrén zài shìdú tōngzhī shàng luò le yìn .
pairs.english: The woman stamped the trial admission notice.
pairs.hanzi: 女人在试读通知上落了印。

pairs.target: " míngé liú wǔtiān . qīxiàn shì gěi nǐ dáfù yòng de ,
pairs.english: “We'll hold the place for five days. That's the time allowed for your answer,
pairs.hanzi: “名额留五天。期限是给你答复用的，

pairs.target: búshì ràng nǐ wǔtiān nèi gǎndào shānshàng .
pairs.english: not a requirement to get up the mountain within five days.
pairs.hanzi: 不是让你五天内赶到山上。

pairs.target: jiālǐ de ānpái , nǐmen zìjǐ tán hǎo . yuànyì lái , píng zhè zhāng lǐngbào dào rìqī . "
pairs.english: Talk through your household arrangements yourselves. If you want to come, use this to obtain your reporting date.”
pairs.hanzi: 家里的安排，你们自己谈好。愿意来，凭这张领报到日期。”

pairs.target: zǒuchū wūzi , sè lā tíng zài yòubiān , ràng guò nàgēn xìguǎn .
pairs.english: Coming out of the room, Sela stopped on the right, keeping clear of the thin tube.
pairs.hanzi: 走出屋子，瑟拉停在右边，让过那根细管。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě tíngxià , gé zhe yíbù kàn niánqīngrén bǎ cājìng de xiǎolún chóngxīn zhuāng huíqù .
pairs.english: Tavi stopped too, watching from a step away as the young person put the cleaned little wheel back in place.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也停下，隔着一步看年轻人把擦净的小轮重新装回去。

pairs.target: " xiǎng wèn jiù wèn . " sè lā shuō , " bié zhàn dé xiàng děng rén gǎn nǐ . "
pairs.english: “Ask if you want to,” Sela said. “Don't stand there as though you're waiting to be chased away.”
pairs.hanzi: “想问就问。”瑟拉说，“别站得像等人赶你。”

pairs.target: niánqīngrén táiqǐ tóu , éqián yì liǔ tóufa tiēzhe hàn .
pairs.english: The young person looked up, a lock of hair plastered with sweat against their forehead.
pairs.hanzi: 年轻人抬起头，额前一绺头发贴着汗。

pairs.target: " tā wèishénme chuī dízǐ ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Why does it whistle?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “它为什么吹笛子？”塔维问。

pairs.target: duìfāng kànkàn tā , yòu kànkàn tóng ké .
pairs.english: The other person looked at him, then at the copper casing.
pairs.hanzi: 对方看看他，又看看铜壳。

pairs.target: " běnlái gāi qiāo líng de . "
pairs.english: “It was supposed to ring a bell.”
pairs.hanzi: “本来该敲铃的。”

pairs.target: sè lā xiān xiào le .
pairs.english: Sela laughed first.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉先笑了。

pairs.target: niánqīngrén yě xiào , bǎ gàizi cháo zìjǐ zhèbiān nuó le nuó ,
pairs.english: The young person laughed too, shifting the cover a little toward themselves,
pairs.hanzi: 年轻人也笑，把盖子朝自己这边挪了挪，

pairs.target: gěi tā lùchū lǐmiàn nàgēn zěnme yě ān bù wěn de tánhuáng .
pairs.english: revealing for him the spring inside that simply would not stay in place.
pairs.hanzi: 给他露出里面那根怎么也安不稳的弹簧。
